sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 6$ in multiplying polynomials, evaluate $f(5)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 11x + 28 = 0$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 4$ and $x = 7$. Factoring $(x - 4)(x - 7) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 4$ and $x = 7$.

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 6x + 7$ in special products, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 6x + 5 = 0$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 1$ and $x = 5$. Factoring $(x - 1)(x - 5) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 1$ and $x = 5$.

questions.q: A data set recorded for special products consists of the four values $\{12, 16, 20, 26\}$. What is the arithmetic mean? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $18.5$. The sum is $12 + 16 + 20 + 26 = 74$, and dividing by $4$ gives $18.5$.
questions.explanation: The sum is $12 + 16 + 20 + 26 = 74$, and dividing by $4$ gives $18.5$.

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 6x + 7$ in special products, evaluate $f(3)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 8x + 12 = 0$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 2$ and $x = 6$. Factoring $(x - 2)(x - 6) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 2$ and $x = 6$.
